test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97c89f7f87115d8beea9fe4b63db763bbf04e88e1bb04cd11cc5a3f1db9efdf8.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) The elements which are placed at the corner, moving anticlock wise direction, and the elements placed in the middle of the side interchanged their position. The center element disappeared and a new element came in the next step. This movement happens in every alternative step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe20a027dc490f010d758bb85cf35f2f4535658a3d3bc86906575f1faec3235.png] 

2) All elements are moving according to a fixed pattern. This movement happens in every alternative step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13c44b8695b052ff0924645421095c828029f2540b9487b2ab969073ede059d2.png] 

3) The elements which are placed at the corner, moving anticlock wise direction, and the elements placed in the middle of the side interchanged their position. The center element disappeared and a new element came in the next step. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc7cdc4d244968222204160c829716ebb4b076662fdbbcd2ec04f01f2a6e13b3.png] 

4) All elements are moving according to a fixed pattern. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/844138605cb6b507b75d91ae2fe20fa21d2dee8c7da56962591fbc62a38bef6b.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc78ed0f596cf9f4ae39cee0b6afabb43a37d4474ff756b2b8e5f06e91d71611.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
